title: Next.js: App Router, SSR/ISR, server components

preview.what: Next.js App Router: server components, SSR, ISR, data fetching.
preview.picture: Pre-cooked meals (static), cooked-to-order (SSR), and cooked-then-kept-warm-for-a-while (ISR). Server components are dishes prepared in the kitchen, not at the table.
preview.why: Next roles ask you to choose a rendering strategy and defend it.
preview.bn: আগে রান্না (static), order-এ রান্না (SSR), রান্না করে কিছুক্ষণ গরম রাখা (ISR); server component = kitchen-এ তৈরি।
